name: rnsp-platform
description: Rwanda National Sports Platform (RNSP / RwaSport) — monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=apps/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run start --workspace=apps/backend" "npm run start --workspace=apps/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/backend
